title: Operator can define penalty lateness threshold
gherkin:
Given an OPERATOR user is logged in
When the operator defines a penalty lateness threshold of 5 days
Then the threshold is stored in the system
And the threshold can be retrieved for penalty calculations
rationale: Verifies that authorized OPERATOR users can create penalty lateness thresholds as stated in the operative context. This is foundational to R102d's requirement that the threshold must be defined.
usedContextItems: Authorized users (OPERATOR or ADMIN roles) can create and modify penalty records before invoice finalization|Penalty lateness threshold must be defined to determine when late-return penalties apply

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)

Date: 2026-03-03 11:00
Subject: Pilot concern about international billing presentation

Hi Team,

Finance has a concern related to the pilot rollout for internationally billed equipment.

For a subset of high-value inventory, we may need a billing presentation approach that works more cleanly across more than one currency context. The current specification covers general pricing and billing expectations, but it does not go into much detail about how pilot-specific currency presentation or conversion rules should be handled in customer-facing outputs.

Before any implementation shortcut is taken, please clarify whether currency conversion, display format, and invoice currency are supposed to be handled as strict accounting rules, temporary pilot behavior, or only a presentation-layer convention. We want to avoid a situation where the operational display becomes simpler, but the customer-visible totals no longer align cleanly with the underlying financial records.

Best,
Finance Dept.

# Documentum ID: TOOLCHAIN-CONF-AVAILABILITY-01
# Description: Availability Management
# Status: Effective

## 4. Availability Management

## 4.1 Availability Calculation
## 4.1.1 The system shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records.
## 4.1.2 The system shall mark an item as unavailable for any period where an Active or Approved rent exists.
## 4.1.3 The system shall ensure that availability calculation prevents overlapping rent periods.
## 4.1.4 The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.

## 4.2 Availability Query
## 4.2.1 The system shall allow users to query item availability for a specified date range.
## 4.2.2 The system shall return availability status indicating whether the item is available or unavailable for the requested period.
## 4.2.3 The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information.

## 4.3 Availability Restrictions

Best,
Finance Dept.
